title: ReviewsReviewAskedPayload
description: Payload of `reviews.review.asked` version 1: the platform asks the customer how their order was, once, between five and thirty minutes after it completed, at a store that takes reviews, unless it was reviewed or the customer said "Not now". Notifications sends the push from it. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's Partner and its `correlation_id` follows the order. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

number.description: The order's number, as said aloud.

partner_id.description: The store's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.

completed_at.description: When the order completed, delivered or collected.

subscription_id.description: The subscription asked about for a month, on the first at 10:00; its order is the month's last delivery. Absent on an order's ask.
